control_profile_contract.rule: required only when requested power is implemented through a current-limit surface; values are domain configuration carried by Foundation, not technical discovery truth

experience_contract.rule: Only explicit canonical unsafe/due values create attention; missing values remain unknown and do not create false alarms.

planning_profile_contract.rule: Planning profile is user/domain intent, not technical discovery truth or OEM setpoint readback.

activity_contract.runtime_scope: latest typed execution result and current asset activity only

legacy_compatibility_contract.rule: Exact R43.2.65 exterior is projected from V2 only; no V1 computation.
